decisions.reason: Rye country bread is an everyday staple of a traditional German bakery that shares production with the rye range and sells steadily at low cost.
The repeatedly gold-medal-winning premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship seasonal product and drives both reputation and revenue.
Seeded rye mixed bread meets established demand and adds little incremental cost to the existing rye production.
Dark malt rye bread is a niche traditional variety that is cheap to maintain, though it remains the most likely candidate for range pruning.
Marzipan stollen is a classic gift and seasonal item that complements the flagship stollen line in the holiday assortment.
The ancient grain 'Meisterstück' taps the health and heritage-grain trend and is promoted as a showcase of the firm's craft.
